mainEntity.name: Is OfferPilot undetectable during screen sharing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The desktop overlay uses the Windows SetWindowDisplayAffinity WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE flag, so it stays visible on your own monitor but is composited out of any screen capture: Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, OBS, or PrintScreen. It also stays out of the taskbar and Alt-Tab.
OfferPilot starts free with 20 minutes per day and no card required. Pro is $19 per month, Ultimate is $29 per month with unlimited use, and Lifetime access is a one-time $299.

mainEntity.name: What is the company-specific Q&A generator?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pick a company and role and OfferPilot builds a tailored interview Q&A database (behavioral, fundamentals, and coding questions with model answers) that the copilot uses to ground its live answers in your background and that company's domain.
